answer_1.quote: a Select-Guide-Generate (SGG) approach is proposed and implemented with a hierarchical neural model for keyphrase generation ... Furthermore, a title generation task indicates the extensibility of SGG in other generation tasks.

answer_2.quote: we adopt top-N macroaveraged F-measure (F1) and recall as our evaluation metrics ... We use ROUGE-1 (unigram), ROUGE-2 (bi-gram), ROUGE-L (LCS) and human evaluation as evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we randomly selects 100 abstracts for each test set, then distribute them to four people on average. The evaluation standard is the fluency of generated title and whether it correctly provides the core topics of an abstract.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluate fluency and whether the title correctly provides the core topics of the abstract.
